name: SAAT - Substance Abuse Awareness Training
source:
Chrissy is the perfect christian girl-next-door, devoted, dismissed, and a little naïve.
Or maybe not.
She needs someone to warn her about the big sins in life: smoking, drinking, drugs, and, obviously, sex.
And who else can that someone be but you?
Get ready for Substance Abuse Awareness Training!
